records.Name: Branch Trading Hours
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer has expressed dissatisfaction with branch trading hours. The customer has explained how this has negatively impacted them.
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: Customer would like branch to return to normal trading hours or have longer hours.
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: I have provided alternative ways to bank and apologised for the inconvenience.

records.Name: Branch Wait Times
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customers is dissatisfied with the branch wait times.
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: An apology for the wait times and reduced wait times when attending a branch.
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Apologised to the customer about the wait time.

records.Name: Appointment required
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer is dissatisfied about the appointment booking process in branch
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: Customer would like to book in an appointment to speak to a banker as soon as possible.

records.Name: Call Disconnected While on Hold
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer was on hold and was disconnected while on hold.
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: Customer would like to speak to a consultant.
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Customer was connected to a consultant.

records.Name: Service Quality Tone or manner of response
Breakfree Package Decommissioning
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer expressed dissatisfaction about  ANZ’s decision to discontinue the Breakfree package.
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Explained the changes to the customer.

records.Name: Internet Banking Outage
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer has expressed concern that they are is unable to access ANZ Internet Banking
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: An apology for the inconvenience and to provide access to the ANZ Internet Banking
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Confirmed that Internet Banking was not working due to known system issue. Provided customer with available information regarding outage and recovery time (if known). Apology provided to customer

records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: I have provided an explanation of the interest rate increase to the customer.

records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: I provided an apology to the customer for the error

records.Name: Interest Rate Increase - Manual resolution details required
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer expressed dissatisfaction with the increase in interest rate.
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: Customer would like rate review and rate reduction.

records.Name: Branch Closures
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer expressed dissatisfaction that the branch was closing down. The customer explained how this has negatively impacted them
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: Do not the close the branch and open more branches
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: I have provided alternative ways to bank and apologised for the inconvenience. I have also advised the customer that the complaint has been logged and is reviewed by ANZ leaders.

records.Name: Interest Rate Not Competitive - Manual resolution details required
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer expressed dissatisfaction with their product interest rate.
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: Customer would like rate review and rate reduction.

records.Name: Deceased Estates Media Coverage \BCCC inquiry
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer is dissatisfied with ANZ’s management of deceased estates as outlined in media coverage related to the BCCC Inquiry
records.IDR_Customer_Desired_Outcome__c: To provide feedback on dissatisfaction, ANZ to improve/remediate
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Apologised and explained that ANZ is continuing to work closely with the BCCC to address the recommendations they have raised but can't comment beyond that.

records.Name: Declined Credit Application
records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Application declined as customer does not meet lending policy.
records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Apologised and educated customer on outcome/lending policy.

records.IDR_Description_of_Issue__c: Customer is unhappy they are unable to download ANZ Shield on their Android device due to compatibility issue

records.IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c: Apology provided and offered/sent Security Token as alternative method of authenticating payments
